objective: Reduce confirmed BGS-owned search contamination and default check-output overhead in initial implementation without restricting source reads or dropping verification evidence.

evidence.measurementBoundary: Counts use actual native function_call_output JSON, excluding wrapper/trailing newline for byte comparisons. Host progress/storage copies are not counted as repeated model input. Byte reductions are not token or end-to-end savings measurements.

planAndSelfReview: Trace large saved outputs to their actual callers and source contracts before changing defaults. Separate explicit cat/JSON.stringify/--appendix/--details from BGS-generated defaults.
Reject the proposed nested-inspections explanation: the saved default layout response has no inspections or measurements array. Its 11 diagnostics carry relevant failed geometry, not all nodes.
Keep complete diagnostics, issues, coverage, failure/unverified/freshness states and explicit detailed reads. Do not create a new projection schema, summary model call or review phase.

Apply the existing host-metadata distinction to ordinary source search with a standard directory-local ignore file, without rewriting shell commands, moving transcripts or changing their UI/export paths.
Initialize this marker only at existing session start/resume events; preserve existing ignore files and transcript persistence. No per-event filesystem maintenance or process-wide state cache.
Remove serialization whitespace at existing CLI output boundaries only. Parsed JSON, checks, exits, retained receipts, text reports and library/MCP results remain unchanged.
Verify with temporary fixtures and existing offline integration checks. Do not repair or rerun the evidence project.

findings.cause: BGS writes durable JSONL transcripts into a visible project directory. Dedicated source navigation, measurement and clone paths exclude it as host metadata, but ordinary recursive rg in a project without ignore rules includes source/code copies retained in those records.
findings.change: On session.started/session.resumed, appendChatTranscript creates transcripts/.ignore with /*.jsonl using exclusive creation. An existing marker is untouched; a symbolic-link directory is skipped. A marker failure cannot prevent an already-appended transcript event.
findings.preserved: Explicit transcript paths and --no-ignore remain readable; JSONL sources elsewhere remain searchable. Artifact discovery and migration enumerate JSONL directly, so the new dotfile does not change their public artifacts.

findings.cause: Default content-check and measurement CLI responses were pretty-printed even after semantic summarization. Formatting whitespace became part of the retained model tool output.
findings.change: Use compact JSON for default content-check and measurement CLI output. Existing --details remains expanded; --format retains its existing compact behavior. No evidence fields are removed or renamed.

excludedConclusions: Full-code and UI JSON reads were explicit Agent commands. No automatic BGS full-source reread mechanism was established, and arbitrary source access was not restricted.
The layout default contains 11 substantive diagnostics. Geometry/corners/required visibility were retained rather than replaced with lossy summaries.
Measurement already removes repeated binding/asset inventories from nested checks. No second field-duplication bug was established.
Repeated preview command text or unchanged-at-boundaries receipts do not establish identical inputs across runs. This task does not change preview retries or project test drivers.
The earlier context-accounting fix remains separate; its benefit is not counted again here.

validation.baseline: Before the marker fix, a temporary no-Git fixture's ordinary rg matched both source JSONL and transcript JSONL.
validation.coverage: Actual rg default/explicit/--no-ignore behavior, source JSONL visibility, resumed and existing markers, symlinks, marker failure without event loss; existing CLI parse/detail/appendix/slow-pipe failure output and measurement/clone/migration contracts.
validation.environment: Initial outer-sandbox execution could not bind localhost or launch nested sandbox-exec. The same offline fixtures passed with those local operations permitted; no real provider or project was invoked.

limitations: No measured end-to-end token savings. These narrow fixes do not remove the entire 8.8M-token implementation phase or all deliberate large reads.

Existing custom ignore files remain authoritative. Idle legacy transcript directories receive the default marker only at the next normal session start/resume; explicit no-ignore searches remain possible.
JSON whitespace is a display change; external consumers should parse complete JSON rather than depend on indentation/line numbers.
No service restart. Unrelated concurrent README/runtime-upgrade/security-test/vendor changes were left untouched and excluded from this commit.
